# ============================================================ # ACHD Surgical Risk Calculator # Model: fullerglm_forshiny (logistic regression, rms/rcs splines) # Required objects in global env: # - glm_with_fuller : fitted glm object # - forauc_app : data.frame with cols prob_fuller, composite_outcome # ============================================================ library(shiny) library(bslib) library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) library(rms) load('data/work_d_for_shiny.RData') knotlocs <- c(18.5, 25, 30, 35, 40) options(datadist = "dd") # ── Fuller procedure lookup table ───────────────────────────── fuller_table <- tibble::tribble( ~procedure, ~score, "ASD repair", 0.1, "PAPVC", 0.2, "Aortic stenosis repair, subvalvular", 0.2, "Conduit reoperation", 0.2, "Pulmonary valve replacement", 0.2, "Pacemaker procedure", 0.2, "Anomalous coronary artery from aorta repair", 0.3, "Aortic valve repair", 0.3, "Vascular ring repair", 0.3, "Ebstein's repair", 0.3, "Explantation of pacing system", 0.3, "AICD procedure", 0.3, "AICD implantation", 0.3, "Pacemaker implantation, permanent", 0.3, "Mitral valve repair", 0.4, "Konno procedure", 0.4, "PA reconstruction", 0.4, "Pulmonic valvuloplasty", 0.4, "Sinus of Valsalva aneurysm repair", 0.4, "RVOT procedure", 0.4, "ALCAPA (not listed)", 0.4, "Aortic root replacement, valve sparing", 0.4, "PAPVC scimitar", 0.4, "Aortic stenosis repair, supravalvular", 0.4, "RV aneurysmal repair", 0.4, "Double-chamber right ventricle repair (DCRV)", 0.4, "Ventricular septal defect repair", 0.5, "Common AV canal repair, incomplete", 0.5, "Aortic arch repair", 0.5, "Aortic valve replacement", 0.6, "Aortic aneurysm repair", 0.6, "Tricuspid valve repair", 0.6, "Systemic venous stenosis repair", 0.6, "TOF repair", 0.6, "Ross procedure", 0.7, "Conduit placement, RV-PA", 0.7, "Arrhythmia surgery – ablation, ventricular", 0.7, "Coarctation repair", 0.8, "Arrhythmia surgery – ablation, atrial", 0.8, "Pericardial drainage", 0.8, "Conduit placement, other", 0.9, "Tricuspid valve replacement", 0.9, "ASD creation/enlargement", 1.0, "Aortic root replacement, non-valve sparing", 1.0, "Shunt, systemic to pulmonary", 1.0, "Mitral valve replacement", 1.5, "Cardiac tumor resection", 1.5, "Coronary artery bypass (congenital heart)", 1.6, "Fontan procedure", 1.8, "Lung transplantation", 2.2, "Heart transplantation", 2.2, "Fontan revision", 3.0 ) %>% arrange(score, procedure) fuller_choices <- setNames( as.list(as.character(fuller_table$score)), sprintf("%-50s [%.1f]", fuller_table$procedure, fuller_table$score) ) # Observed ranges from training data (for out-of-range warnings) obs_ranges <- list( bmi = c(16, 54), albumin = c(18, 53), age = c(3, 82) ) # ── UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ui <- page_sidebar( title = tags$span( tags$img(src = NULL), # placeholder for logo if desired style = "font-size:2rem; font-weight:700;", "Hybrid patient- and procedure-based perioperative risk in ACHD surgery" ), theme = bs_theme( version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly", primary = "#1b4f72", "sidebar-bg" = "#eaf0f6" ), sidebar = sidebar( width = 460, title = tags$span(style = "font-weight:600;", "Enter Patient Parameters"), # Disclaimer div( class = "alert alert-warning p-2 mb-3", style = "font-size:0.877rem; line-height:1.4;", tags$strong("⚠ Research use only."), " This model was derived from a training cohort and", " has not been externally validated.", " Predictions do not replace clinical judgement." ), # ── BMI ────────────────────────────────────────────────── numericInput("bmi", "BMI (kg/m²)", value = 27, min = 0, max = 100, step = 0.1), uiOutput("warn_bmi"), # ── Age ────────────────────────────────────────────────── numericInput("age", "Age (years)", value = 41, min = 0, max = 100, step = 1), uiOutput("warn_age"), # ── Albumin ────────────────────────────────────────────── numericInput("albumin", "Albumin (g/L)", value = 41, min = 0, max = 100, step = 0.5), uiOutput("warn_albumin"), # ── Cognitive impairment (binary toggle) ───────────────── div( class = "mb-3", tags$label( HTML( "Cognitive impairment
Third party signing the informed consent for surgery " ), class = "form-label" ), div( class = "btn-group w-100", role = "group", tags$button( id = "btn_cogn_no", type = "button", class = "btn btn-outline-primary active", onclick = "setBinary('cogn', 0)", "No" ), tags$button( id = "btn_cogn_yes", type = "button", class = "btn btn-outline-primary", onclick = "setBinary('cogn', 1)", "Yes" ) ), tags$input(type = "hidden", id = "cogn_impair_val", value = "0") ), # ── Ventricular dysfunction (binary toggle) ─────────────── div( class = "mb-3", tags$label( HTML( "Ventricular dysfunction
Ejection Fraction < 40% " ), class = "form-label" ), div( class = "btn-group w-100", role = "group", tags$button( id = "btn_ef_no", type = "button", class = "btn btn-outline-primary active", onclick = "setBinary('ef', 0)", "No" ), tags$button( id = "btn_ef_yes", type = "button", class = "btn btn-outline-primary", onclick = "setBinary('ef', 1)", "Yes" ) ), tags$input(type = "hidden", id = "compr_EF_val", value = "0") ), # ── Prior chest wall incisions ──────────────────────────── div( class = "mb-3", tags$label("Prior chest wall incisions (sternotomy / thoracotomy)", class = "form-label"), div( class = "btn-group w-100 flex-wrap", role = "group", lapply(0:5, function(i) { tags$button( id = paste0("btn_inc_", i), type = "button", class = if (i == 0) "btn btn-outline-primary active" else "btn btn-outline-primary", onclick = sprintf("setIncisions(%d)", i), as.character(i) ) }) ), tags$input(type = "hidden", id = "prior_incisions_val", value = "0") ), hr(), # ── ACHS Score (Fuller) ─────────────────────────────────── tags$label("ACHS Complexity Score", class = "form-label fw-bold"), radioButtons("fuller_mode", label = NULL, choices = c("Enter score directly" = "direct", "Select procedure" = "lookup"), selected = "direct", inline = TRUE), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.fuller_mode == 'direct'", numericInput("max_score_direct", label = "Score (0.1 – 3.0)", value = 0.5, min = 0.1, max = 3.0, step = 0.1) ), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.fuller_mode == 'lookup'", selectInput("max_score_lookup", label = "Select procedure", choices = fuller_choices, selected = "0.5") ), hr(), actionButton("calculate", "Calculate Risk", class = "btn btn-primary w-100 fw-bold fs-5", icon = icon("calculator")) ), # ── Main panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────── layout_columns( col_widths = c(6, 6), card( card_header(tags$strong("Predicted Risk")), card_body( uiOutput("risk_display"), hr(), uiOutput("percentile_display") ) ), card( card_header(tags$strong("Position in Reference Cohort")), card_body( plotOutput("dist_plot", height = "300px"), div( class = "text-muted mt-2", style = "font-size:1rem;", "Density of predicted probabilities in the training cohort (n = ", textOutput("n_cohort", inline = TRUE), ").", " Blue = no outcome; red = outcome.", " Dashed red line = this patient's predicted probability." ) ) ) ), # JS for binary toggles and incision selector tags$head(tags$script(HTML(" function setBinary(field, val) { if (field === 'cogn') { document.getElementById('cogn_impair_val').value = val; document.getElementById('btn_cogn_no').classList.toggle('active', val === 0); document.getElementById('btn_cogn_yes').classList.toggle('active', val === 1); } else { document.getElementById('compr_EF_val').value = val; document.getElementById('btn_ef_no').classList.toggle('active', val === 0); document.getElementById('btn_ef_yes').classList.toggle('active', val === 1); } // notify Shiny Shiny.setInputValue(field === 'cogn' ? 'cogn_impair_val' : 'compr_EF_val', String(val)); } function setIncisions(n) { document.getElementById('prior_incisions_val').value = n; for (var i = 0; i <= 5; i++) { var btn = document.getElementById('btn_inc_' + i); if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', i === n); } Shiny.setInputValue('prior_incisions_val', n); } // Initialise hidden inputs into Shiny on load document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { Shiny.setInputValue('cogn_impair_val', '0'); Shiny.setInputValue('compr_EF_val', '0'); Shiny.setInputValue('prior_incisions_val', 0); }); "))) ) # ── Server ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── server <- function(input, output, session) { # Out-of-range warnings make_warn <- function(val, varname) { renderUI({ req(!is.na(val())) lo <- obs_ranges[[varname]][1] hi <- obs_ranges[[varname]][2] if (!is.null(val()) && (val() < lo || val() > hi)) { div(class = "alert alert-danger p-1 mt-1", style = "font-size:0.75rem;", sprintf("⚠ Outside training range (%.0f – %.0f): extrapolation applies.", lo, hi)) } }) } output$warn_bmi <- make_warn(reactive(input$bmi), "bmi") output$warn_age <- make_warn(reactive(input$age), "age") output$warn_albumin <- make_warn(reactive(input$albumin), "albumin") # ── Prediction ────────────────────────────────────────────── result <- eventReactive(input$calculate, { # Fuller score: display value × 10 → model input fuller_raw <- if (input$fuller_mode == "direct") { as.numeric(input$max_score_direct) } else { as.numeric(input$max_score_lookup) } max_score_model <- fuller_raw * 10 # as stored in reddata new_pt <- data.frame( bmi = as.numeric(input$bmi), cogn_impair = as.integer(input$cogn_impair_val %||% 0), prior_incisions = as.integer(input$prior_incisions_val %||% 0), albumin = as.numeric(input$albumin), age = as.numeric(input$age), compr_EF = as.integer(input$compr_EF_val %||% 0), max_score = max_score_model ) lp <- predict(fullerglm_forshiny, newdata = new_pt, type = "link") prob <- plogis(lp) # Percentile in training cohort ref_probs <- forauc_app$prob_fuller pctile <- round(100 * mean(ref_probs <= prob, na.rm = TRUE), 1) list( prob = as.numeric(prob), lp = as.numeric(lp), pctile = pctile, fuller_shown = fuller_raw ) }) # ── Risk display ───────────────────────────────────────────── output$risk_display <- renderUI({ req(result()) prob <- result()$prob pct <- round(prob * 100, 1) #color <- if (prob < 0.05) "#1e8449" else if (prob < 0.15) "#d68910" else "#c0392b" label <- if (prob < 0.05) "Low" else if (prob < 0.15) "Moderate" else "High" pctile <- result()$pctile color <- if (pctile > 75) "#c0392b" else if (pctile > 50) "#d68910" else "#1e8449" tagList( div(style = "text-align:center; padding: 12px 0;", tags$span( style = sprintf("font-size:4rem; font-weight:800; color:%s; line-height:1;", color), sprintf("%.1f%%", pct) ), # tags$br(), # tags$span( # class = "badge mt-1", # style = sprintf("background-color:%s; font-size:0.95rem; padding:6px 14px;", color), # label, " Risk" # ), # tags$br(), tags$br(), # tags$span( # style = "font-size:0.82rem; color:#666;", # sprintf("Linear predictor (log-odds): %.3f", result()$lp) # ), tags$br(), tags$span( style = "font-size:0.82rem; color:#666;", sprintf("ACHS score entered: %.1f", result()$fuller_shown) ) ) ) }) # ── Percentile display ──────────────────────────────────────── output$percentile_display <- renderUI({ req(result()) pctile <- result()$pctile color <- if (pctile > 75) "#c0392b" else if (pctile > 50) "#d68910" else "#1e8449" div( style = "text-align:center; padding:8px 0;", tags$span(style = "font-size:0.88rem; color:#555;", "Percentile vs. training cohort"), tags$br(), tags$span( style = sprintf("font-size:2.8rem; font-weight:700; color:%s;", color), pctile, tags$sup("th", style = "font-size:1.4rem;") ), tags$br(), tags$span( style = "font-size:0.78rem; color:#888;", sprintf("Higher than %.1f%% of training cohort predictions", pctile) ) ) }) # ── Distribution plot ───────────────────────────────────────── output$dist_plot <- renderPlot({ req(result()) prob <- result()$prob ref_data <- forauc_app %>% mutate( outcome_label = factor( composite_outcome, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No composite outcome", "Composite outcome") ) ) ggplot(ref_data, aes(x = prob_fuller, fill = outcome_label)) + geom_histogram( aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 45, alpha = 0.70, position = "stack", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15 ) + # geom_density( # aes(x = prob_fuller), # inherit.aes = FALSE, # colour = "#1b4f72", # linewidth = 0.9, # fill = NA # ) + geom_vline( xintercept = prob, colour = "#c0392b", linewidth = 1.3, linetype = "dashed" ) + annotate( "label", x = pmin(prob + 0.03, 0.85), y = Inf, vjust = 1.6, label = sprintf("This patient\n%.1f%%", prob * 100), colour = "#c0392b", fill = "white", size = 5, label.size = 0.3, fontface = "bold" ) + scale_fill_manual( values = c( "No composite outcome" = "#aed6f1", "Composite outcome" = "#f1948a" ) ) + scale_x_continuous( labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1) ) + labs( x = "Predicted probability", y = "Density", fill = NULL ) + theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + # theme( # legend.position = "top", # legend.text = element_text(size = 10), # panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # axis.title = element_text(size = 10), # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1) # ) theme( legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 15), legend.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"), axis.text = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16), panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ) }) output$n_cohort <- renderText(nrow(forauc_app)) } # Null coalescing helper (base R < 4.4 doesn't have %||%) `%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a) && !is.na(a) && nchar(as.character(a)) > 0) a else b shinyApp(ui, server)
